displayName: OCI-PCI-023: PCI-DSS — Insecure Password Policy in CDE
description:
Detects accounts in cardholder data environment with password policies not meeting PCI-DSS requirements

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: pci-dss — insecure password policy in cde

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_pci_023", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%pci%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%dss%') AND "value" > 0
